name: Ahrefs
description: Ahrefs is an AI-powered marketing platform built on a proprietary index of the web, giving SEO specialists, content marketers, and agencies tools for keyword research, backlink analysis, site auditing, and AI visibility tracking.
best_for: Positioned for SEO specialists, content marketers, PPC specialists, brand marketers, and agencies — the vendor reports marketers at 44% of the Fortune 500 use Ahrefs.
features: Keywords Explorer for keyword research and search volume data
Site Explorer and backlink analysis built on a proprietary web index
Rank Tracker for monitoring search rankings
Brand Radar for AI visibility tracking across LLM answers
Site Audit for technical SEO health checks
Content Explorer and AI Content Helper for content research and optimization
Web Analytics and Bot Analytics for website performance
Local SEO tools including Google Business Profile monitoring
